target_audience.raw: Homeowners with lawns up to 3,000 m² (0.75 acre) wanting wire-free robotic mowing. Inferred from website positioning — no intake form provided.
target_audience.demographics: Homeowners, 35-65, suburban/semi-rural, mid-to-upper income, US/UK/EU/AU markets, lawn size 500-3000 m²
target_audience.psychographics: Hates yardwork, values weekends back, skeptical of boundary-wire setup hassle, tech-forward enough to consider robots, wants premium without fiddling. Has rejected or returned Husqvarna/Worx because wire install was a project.
pain_points: Boundary-wire installation takes a full weekend and looks ugly crossing the yard
RTK-based mowers lose signal under trees or near walls — exactly where you need reliability
Every Saturday morning is mowing morning; weekends feel like chores
Traditional mowers miss edges near flowerbeds, fences, patios
Paying £2,000+ and still having to do the edges by hand feels like a con
desires: Robot that sets up in 10 minutes, not a weekend
Works under trees, near walls, in tight corners — no 'dead zones'
Cuts edges cleanly, not just open lawn
Handles slopes and rain without babysitting
Premium build that survives multiple seasons
Anti-theft (it's sitting in the garden every day)

offer.main_offer: FJD FL3000 LiDAR Robotic Mower — wire-free, RTK-free autonomous lawn care for up to 3,000 m²
offer.result_promise: 10-minute setup. Perfect lawn. No more Saturdays behind a push-mower.

differentiator.raw: LiDAR + vision fusion navigation — no boundary wire, no RTK. Works reliably under trees, next to walls, in tight corners where both wire-based and RTK-based competitors fail. 10-minute setup.
key_points: No wire — no ugly install, no digging, no cut-wire callouts
No RTK — no signal drops under trees or near buildings
360° LiDAR + semantic vision for real obstacle avoidance
Smart edge trimming (LiDAR+vision fusion at the perimeter)
Automatic rain detection, auto-return, IPX5 waterproof
Electric deck auto-lifting, fast blade swap

trust_signals.raw: Global FJDynamics brand — parent company is a major agtech / autonomous vehicle manufacturer (autonomous tractors, construction nav, GNSS/RTK). Precision-robotics lineage applied to residential mowing.
credentials: FJDynamics — agtech and autonomous vehicle manufacturer
LiDAR + vision fusion (the same sensor-stack used in autonomous tractors)
Hardware specs exposed publicly (190WH battery, 180min runtime, 33° max climb)

client_acquisition.method: Online product page with 'Buy Now' (external store) and 'Free Quote' lead form
client_acquisition.funnel: Ad → product page → Buy Now (DTC) or Free Quote (dealer lead)

ad_strategy.recommended_objective: Conversions (Shop Now) primary; Landing Page Views as a cheaper prospecting layer
ad_strategy.funnel_stage_focus: Mid-funnel prospecting + retargeting — category-aware homeowners who've searched 'robot lawn mower' or seen competitor ads
ad_strategy.audience_notes: This is DTC, not B2B. Visuals are product-forward. Copy speaks to the buyer (the homeowner) directly. Lead angles: (1) No wire / 10-min setup, (2) Works where RTK fails, (3) Premium spec at the price, (4) Reclaim your Saturdays. Position against Husqvarna Automower (wire) and Mammotion Luba (RTK) without naming them directly — let the spec comparison do the work.
